title: StarArea
description: Searching for a vanilla survival server? With BE support! Still worrying about your base while you're away? At StarArea, every bit of your effort stays safe and sound.
body:
StarArea is a lightweight survival-focused server dedicated to creating a harmonious, fair, fun, and safe social gaming environment. Whether you are a solo builder or an adventurer who loves collaboration, StarArea offers a starry sky where you can freely unleash your creativity.

QQ：162733385
Discord：[ME](https://discord.gg/dMecVd3bmT)

🌌 Long-Term Stability for Peace of Mind

· The server is backed by stable hardware support and professional operation management, designed for long-term availability.

· Every bit of your effort and every block you place will not disappear due to sudden server shutdowns. We encourage long-term planning, helping you build legendary projects of your own.

🤝 Friendly Community, Harmonious Atmosphere
· We have a warm and welcoming player community. Griefing, stealing, and any behavior that negatively impacts others' gameplay are prohibited.

· Dedicated player communication channels are available, where you can share your achievements, team up for adventures, trade resources, and easily find like-minded companions.

🏡 Land Protection, Respect for Creativity

· A comprehensive land claim system protects your hard-built homes and farms from being destroyed by others. You can log off with peace of mind, without worrying about returning to chaos.

🎯 Quality-of-Life Enhancements, Streamlined Experience

· Sleep Majority: Only 50% of players need to sleep to skip the night.

StarArea是一個以輕量生存爲主的服務器，我們致力於打造一個和諧、公平、有趣且安全的遊戲社交環境。無論 你是獨行的建造大師，還是熱衷協作的探險家，StarArea 都爲你預留了一片可以自由揮灑創意的星空。

QQ：162733385

🌌 長久穩定，安心發展

· 服務器擁有穩定的硬件支持和專業的運維管理，旨在 長期開放。

· 你的每一份努力、建造的每一個方塊都不會因爲服務器的突然關閉而消失。我們鼓勵長期規劃，打造屬於你傳奇工程。

🤝社區友好，氛圍和諧

· 我們擁有一個熱情而友善的玩家社區。禁止偷竊、惡意破壞等一切影響他人遊戲體驗的行爲。

· 設有專用的玩家交流羣，在這裏你可以分享成果、組隊探險、交易物資，輕鬆找到志同道合的夥伴。

🏡领地保护，尊重创造

· 完善的領地保護系統，讓你辛苦建造的家園和農場免受他人破壞。你可以安心下線，不必擔心歸來時一片狼藉。

🎯 適度優化，便捷體驗

· 半數睡眠：僅需50%睡覺即可跳過夜晚。
